method: Visual inspection of the saved 1024x1536 native PNG and unresampled console/window inspection crops; every named component must coexist in this image.

gates.owner: The fictional adult, their visible face, the console and meter fixtures, and the framed radio dish within one control-cabin view

component_results.requirement: The adult face remains identifiable at environmental portrait scale
component_results.evidence: Adult face and short hair occupy the left of the environmental frame.

component_results.requirement: A task-specific console, meter faces, and radio dish establish the actual control cabin
component_results.evidence: Console, meters and exterior radio dish are visible as task-specific apparatus.

component_results.requirement: The adult right hand connects to the console selector as part of the power-test task
component_results.evidence: Right hand contacts the main power selector on that console.

component_results.requirement: The frame retains enough cabin and dish context to explain the task
component_results.evidence: The frame includes the surrounding cabin window, dish and console beyond the face.

gates.owner: The adult right hand, red knurled selector, and amber status lamps on the same console

component_results.requirement: The specific right-hand turning action is visible
component_results.evidence: Right hand is visibly turning the large red main-power selector.

component_results.requirement: The red selector target is visible with that hand in the same frame
component_results.evidence: The red selector is in the same frame directly under the fingertips.

component_results.requirement: The hand visibly grips the selector through a plausible wrist-arm path
component_results.evidence: Wrist, forearm and knob contact form a reachable path without separation.

component_results.requirement: Amber lamps on that console show an immediate state change linked to the turned selector
component_results.evidence: Amber status lamps above the selector are lit on the same console; the still frame shows a plausible immediate power-on state, although it cannot prove the sequence timing.

gates.owner: The red selector grip, its small polished ridges, the neighboring intact coating, and the selector base material

component_results.requirement: The red selector base material retains its own limited metal or coated reflection response
component_results.evidence: The red knob and nearby metal have distinguishable reflective responses.

component_results.requirement: Small polished wear sits at the ridges that the right fingertips can reach
component_results.evidence: At 1024-pixel native size, bright marks on the red ridges read as broad specular bands; a separate small worn patch under or adjacent to the fingertips is not distinguishable.

component_results.requirement: Wear strength is modest for a functional control cabin and does not cover all surfaces
component_results.evidence: Wear is not visually established as a modest, contact-local trace; surrounding steel has general fine surface marks.

component_results.requirement: The selector edge and local highlights remain coherent beneath the worn patches
component_results.evidence: The knob rim remains one continuous solid shape with coherent edge highlights.

gates.owner: The matte charcoal console surround, adjacent brushed-steel rim, and cabin window under the same light

component_results.requirement: The matte charcoal surround has broad subdued shading
component_results.evidence: Matte black console panel holds subdued shading.

component_results.requirement: The brushed-steel rim shows a narrower localized highlight
component_results.evidence: Brushed steel rim and panel edge catch narrow warm highlights.

component_results.requirement: The adjacent glass has a separate faint reflection while transmitting the exterior dish
component_results.evidence: Window carries faint amber interior lamp reflections while the exterior dish remains visible through it.

gates.owner: Adult eyes, both hands and selector in the selected plane; meter faces at middle depth; exterior dish farther away

component_results.requirement: Adult eyes, both hands, and selector stay crisp
component_results.evidence: Eyes, hands and selector have readable crisp contours.

component_results.requirement: Intermediate meter faces remain recognizable
component_results.evidence: Middle-distance meter dials and labels remain recognizable.

component_results.requirement: The far dish loses fine detail while retaining its dish shape
component_results.evidence: Exterior dish remains recognizable while fine strut detail is softer than the selected subject and console.

gates.owner: Adult right hand, red selector, and amber status lamps on the same console

component_results.requirement: Right hand visibly contacts and turns the red selector
component_results.evidence: Right fingers enclose and touch the red main-power selector.

component_results.requirement: Amber status lamps above that selector visibly illuminate
component_results.evidence: Five amber lamps glow above the control.

component_results.requirement: Selector and lamps share one coherent console layout and reachable action
component_results.evidence: The knob and lamps share the same visible console panel with a credible reach.

gates.owner: Fictional adult face and hair compared only to visible appearance in the attached portrait

component_results.requirement: Clearly adult-looking face visible in three-quarter view
component_results.evidence: A visibly adult face remains clear in a three-quarter angle.

component_results.requirement: Short dark bob with loose wispy bangs visible
component_results.evidence: Short dark bob and wispy bangs are visible.

component_results.requirement: Soft oval face and dark eyes plausibly follow the visible appearance guidance
component_results.evidence: Dark eyes and a soft oval face follow the supplied portrait as appearance guidance; no identity comparison is inferred.

interpretation_limits: A still frame cannot prove the lamp illumination sequence in time; it can show a lit result adjacent to the operated selector.
The portrait comparison is limited to visible adult face and hair appearance, not personal identity.
